description: Stand up Agora Studio's UI shell/backbone: a new source-first TypeScript + React 19 + Vite workspace (`studio/`) alongside the conformance `console/`, ships with NO preconfigured apps/services/connections. Studio is an observer, never a hub — traffic never flows through it (ADR-0001). The cast is learned at runtime (capability, never caller — the same rule the whole tree obeys per CLAUDE.md): participants come ONLY from the user's own configuration (rosetta is the internal dogfood per rosetta's roadmap, and is never bundled here), never a hard-wired roster or a project-name literal. This is the backbone the topology graph (61), connection monitoring (62), message viewer (63), analytics (64), spec viewer (65), and example setups (66) all build on. Scope: a new `studio/` npm workspace mirroring `console/`'s layout/conventions (`exports` → `src/index.ts`, nothing emitted, tests as `*.test.ts(x)` next to their subject, React+Vite deps), added to the root `workspaces` array with a `check-studio` Makefile target wired into `check-ts`/`make check`. agora gates on `make check`.

userStories.title: A source-first studio/ workspace scaffold gated like the rest of the tree
userStories.description: Create the `studio/` package as a new npm workspace mirroring `console/`'s toolchain (React 19 + Vite, `type: module`, `private: true`), source-first per CLAUDE.md, and wire its gate into the Makefile so `make check` covers it.
acceptanceCriteria: A new `studio/` workspace exists as `@agora/studio` (private), added to the root `package.json` `workspaces` array, with `exports`/tsconfig pointing at `src/index.ts` and nothing emitted (source-first, matching `console/`); it depends on the in-repo `@agora/schemas`/`@agora/sdk`/`@agora/registry`/`@agora/resolver` workspaces by `*` rather than re-implementing any of them

A `check-studio` Makefile target is added (mirroring `check-console`'s `ts-area PKG=@agora/studio` shape) and the `studio/` area is covered by `make check` via `check-ts` (which runs `npm run lint` + `npm run typecheck` + `npm run test`)

`make check` is green: `npm run lint` (root eslint flat config) clean, `npm run typecheck` (`tsc -p`, `--noEmit`) clean, and `vitest` passes for the new package; at least one `src/*.test.tsx` renders the shell

userStories.title: An empty-by-default backbone with no preconfigured participants
userStories.description: The shell renders with NO bundled apps/services/connections and no project-name literal anywhere in the tree — an empty backbone that shows a clear empty state until a user's config supplies a cast.
acceptanceCriteria: With no configuration provided, Studio renders an explicit empty state (zero nodes, zero connections) and carries NO hard-wired roster and no project-name literal (grep-clean per CLAUDE.md's capability-never-caller rule — any project name present is marked sample/attributed, never a runtime default)
A test asserts the backbone lists zero participants when given empty/absent config, and that participants are sourced only from data passed in at runtime (never imported statically)
The shell is observer-only: it holds no code path that relays or proxies traffic between participants (ADR-0001); `make check` green

userStories.title: Runtime config ingestion that produces the cast
userStories.description: Read the user's own participant configuration and derive the cast from it, so the same backbone is empty for a fresh install and populated for a configured one (rosetta is the internal dogfood, referenced by shape, never bundled).
acceptanceCriteria: Studio ingests a user-supplied config describing participants/connections and derives the on-screen cast from it at runtime; the config format is self-describing and lives with the user (per the ecosystem's config-lives-in-the-project rule), not baked into `studio/`

A test drives ingestion with a synthetic, non-project-specific config and asserts the cast reflects it exactly (add/remove a participant → the backbone reflects it), while an empty config still yields the empty state from US-2
`make check` green; Studio stays source-first (no build emit introduced)
